principles.name: Authorization
principles.text: Technical access does not automatically establish permission or authority.

principles.name: Privacy
principles.text: Permission to access data and the later collection, use, retention and sharing of data are distinct questions.

principles.name: Evidence
principles.text: Digital artifacts should be interpreted with context, provenance and limits.

principles.name: Attribution
principles.text: A technical identifier such as an IP address is evidence, not automatic proof of a human actor.

principles.name: Incident response
principles.text: Preserve useful evidence, contain harm, secure accounts and report through appropriate official channels.
